text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance (empagliflozin) include urinary tract infections (UTIs), genital yeast infections, and increased urination.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections (UTIs), genital yeast infections, and increased urination

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning when you pee, pelvic pain, or cloudy urine.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, or discharge in women or men.
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more often or waking up at night to pee.
Upper respiratory infections: Symptoms like a common cold or sore throat.
Increased thirst: Due to fluid loss from frequent urination.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, marked by nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing, even with normal blood sugar levels.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Extreme fluid loss causing dizziness or fainting when standing up.
Severe genital or perineal infections: A rare but life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin (Fournier's gangrene).
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if taken with insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower limb amputations: Increased risk of toe, foot, or leg pain, sores, or ulcers.

text_blocks.snippet: If you are taking Jardiance, tell me if you are experiencing any specific symptoms or taking other medications like insulin or diuretics so I can provide more relevant information.
